name: B1 metered-energy relative incentive effects v1
purpose: Remove unnecessary absolute-reference dependency for relative incentive effects; retain standard AIPW estimator and existing event-process default.
domain: complete one-minute intervals, fixed30minute1.5kW task; all supplied events including nonresponse; same pre-treatment task across arms
outcome: Z=-sum(actual_power*width)/(q*T); positive contrast means less actual energy than reference incentive arm. Absolute Z means are NOT net-delivery eta or capacity.
identity: With a treatment-invariant natural reference and pre-fixed common W,Q, eta(d)-eta(d0)=Z(d)-Z(d0). Refit finite-sample nuisance models may differ; no universal RMSE improvement claim.
implementation: One optional input wrapper, validates identities/time grid/complete aligned task/duplicate events/no implicit dropping; delegates to existing standard multivalued AIPW, user folds and cluster inference. Existing APIs/defaults unchanged.
generator: Reuse frozen causal simulation formulas on new seeds. Natural normalized baseline b=3+.35X0+.2X1+.15X2+.1X0^2+.12*independent_user_latent; predicted reference bhat=2.75+.2X0+.2X1, a pre-treatment function only. Measured average power=1.5*(b-y); full30 bins preserve this integral. Baseline has positive physical margin relative to all noiseless potential outcomes; no clipping.
comparisons: standard AIPW on biased but pre-treatment predicted-reference eta
meter-only wrapper using the same standard AIPW
validation: Independent interval integral and potential-contrast algebra; wrapper vs direct standard AIPW point agreement; synchronous auxiliary shift identity; invalid/missing/bool/string/grid/duplicate/mixed-task/no-predeclaration/sparse-support cases. Observational assignment uses only supplied X. Deterministic support refusal retained.
inference: 20 independent seed blocks; four paired scenarios, three paired outcomes. Existing999 user Gaussian multipliers and95% simultaneous bands; report observed coverage denominators, not proof of exact95% coverage. Group users, not repeated events.
adoption: Optional input functionality only if contract tests and algebra/direct-baseline checks pass and independent review finds no target mistake. Numerical superiority is not required or asserted. One frozen experiment, no tuning to beat AIPW.
stop: No process model retuning, no new reference correction, no real-data claim, no report. New runtime source only under B1算法 after validation; experimental source stays work.
